attBesluta.text: Very happy with my reformer box. It is solid and sturdy and extremely good value for money compared to other boxes. Highly recommend
Ormai lo sto utilizzando da mesi e devo dire che è molto robusto e ben fatto. Ne consiglio l’acquisto!

This item was the best price I could find on the online market. It arrived in good time and is a fine sturdy box to go with my pilates table. The only issue I had was that the brackets were missing and the support team were excellent. They could not locate a replacement from the production company and instead offered me a partial refund. I should easily find some locally so I am well pleased and highly recommend this company.
Super snelle levering! Echt een kwalitatieve reformer box! heel blij mee
Preis-Leistung absolut super! Wie erwartet, auch weich genug! Nutze es für das Training am Pilates reformer zuhause.

Buy this. This is what u are missing from ur Pilates carriage system. Gives u so many more moves I kept mine as collapsing capable for easy storage and it's totally sturdy. No issues at all when using
The sides fold in and out easily for Storage and it’s sturdy construction, but it’s rather heavy.

Needed something like this for a while now. Protects my instrument really well and the latches feel secure. The fabric construction feels solid and dependable. Looks smart and does not feel cheap. No issues so far, working as it should. Recommended.

Had my primary bathroom remodelled and decided to install vessel sinks instead of in counter sinks. The model I chose is absolutely beautiful in my ”new” bathroom. I researched many websites and stores and decided to order from Vevor because of the selection choices, the price, and the speedy delivery!
Very happy with the Quality of the vanity basin fast delivery
Lovely sink and excellent value for money. I would definitely recommend this sink and I would definitely buy again if I ever need a similar sink.
Compra 100% recomendable, si estás dudando de su resistencia es muy buena. Además. sus agarres son firmes y no se deforman ni despegan. Tampoco pierde agua por ninguna parte.
Great product. Every bit as high quality as more expensive brand names. Use it weekly!
Excellent bag, excellent price. Works as well as more expensive bag at my therapist.
The item itself is of good quality. Not sure what the purpose of the pump accessory is as it cannot be attached to the valve and, in general, looks like an afterthought addition.
